rule_1_derivation_plan.note: Every number below is derived or cited; the tool authors none. The same laws and the same cited constants as the A lane -- B introduces NO new constants.
rule_1_derivation_plan.volume_law: V_k = |sum over faces (1/6) * v_a . (v_b x v_c)| -- divergence theorem on the compartment's own triangles (the exact triangles that go resident), CT mm frame.
rule_1_derivation_plan.area_law: A_k = sum over faces 0.5*|(v_b - v_a) x (v_c - v_a)|, accumulated exactly as the kernel validator accumulates it.
rule_1_derivation_plan.thickness_law: t_k = V_k / A_k -- the equivalent shell thickness that conserves the measured volume; with it the kernel's mass law (area x thickness x density) reproduces V_k * rho exactly. The only derived parameter; computed per compartment, never chosen.
rule_1_derivation_plan.mass_law: m_k = V_k * rho_bone; rho_bone = 1900 kg/m^3 = 1.9e-6 kg/mm^3, the SAME cited adult cortical wet density upper anchor as A (Cowin / Currey; Feldmann et al. 1800-2100). No infant-macaque tissue-density citation exists; the bias is named, not tuned.
rule_1_derivation_plan.bond_law: Bond set = measured touching_edges of bone_identification_v3.json specimen 000875599 restricted to pairs whose BOTH members carry a v3 segment_label: the hind chain [3,7,19,21,24] contributes {3-19 2.97, 7-19 0.53, 7-24 2.62, 19-24 2.94, 21-24 0.93} and the fore chain [5,8,9,11] contributes {5-9 2.71, 5-11 1.48, 8-9 0.70} = 8 bonds. Per bond: material = cartilage, cure_strength = 13 MPa (Yamada 1970), rest_length_mm = measured gap_mm. Excluded measured edges (7, itemized in verify.json): unknown chain {14-23 0.96, 14-25 0.92, 23-25 0.72} (all endpoints unidentified) and fragment pairs {2-16 1.24, 4-20 0.47, 6-10 0.36, 12-15 0.57} (one endpoint unidentified each). Bond geometry is measured, never authored.
rule_1_derivation_plan.total_check: Imported subset: M = sum of the 14 m_k, checked against the identified-subset voxel book 6363.0541 mm3 -> 12.0898 g (5%). Literature binding on the FULL book: all 25 manifest ranks = 30857.3061 mm3 -> 58.6289 g at the same density, window 30-65 g (rhesus infant birth mass 400-550 g, NC3Rs; skeleton fraction 8-15%, mammalian range; Prange, Anderson & Rahn 1979 M_skel = 0.0708 * M_body^1.09 -> 26.08-36.9 g over the band, adult-taxon).
